[ASSISTANT_SAID] Calcium is an essential nutrient for chickens, especially for laying hens, as it plays a critical role in eggshell formation and overall bone health.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recipe for a calcium-rich feed supplement for chickens includes:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2 cups of crushed oyster shells (or crushed eggshells)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1 cup of dark leafy greens (such as kale, spinach, or collard greens)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1/2 cup of dried mealworms (optional)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1/4 cup of plain, unflavored yogurt (optional)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for the supplement: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl until well combined and store in an airtight container.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Feeding instructions: Offer 1-2 tablespoons of the supplement per chicken per day.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Crushed oyster shells or eggshells are excellent sources of calcium carbonate.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Dark leafy greens provide additional calcium and other essential vitamins and minerals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Dried mealworms are a good source of protein (optional).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Plain, unflavored yogurt provides probiotics (optional).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips include providing fresh water and a balanced, nutrient-rich commercial layer feed as the main staple of the chickens' diet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User asked if crushed oyster shells or eggshells would be safe for their mare, Starlight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Crushed oyster shells or eggshells are not suitable for horses due to their different calcium needs and potential digestive issues.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended calcium sources for horses include calcium carbonate, dicalcium phosphate, and limestone.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should consult with an equine nutritionist or veterinarian for personalized advice on Starlight's calcium needs.  
[EVENT] User plans to schedule a consultation with their veterinarian to review Starlight, Bessie, and Billy's vaccination records.
